Name: Custom Transparency
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod lets you change how transparent trees and buildings become when you walk behind them.
Description:
Custom Transparency

This mod lets you change how transparent trees and buildings become when you walk behind them.

By default, it makes trees/buildings twice as transparent than normal. To change the value yourself, run the game once and then close it to generate a config.json file, and then edit the config.json file. The format is a number between 0 and 1, with the game's default being 0.4 and this mod changing that to 0.2 by default.

Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.
